description: This file defines a PHP trait 'AwsClientTrait' that provides common functionalities for AWS SDK client classes, such as pagination, iteration, waiting for operations, executing commands asynchronously or synchronously, and dynamic method calls for AWS service interactions.

methods.name: getPaginator
methods.description: Returns a paginator object for iterating through paginated API results for a specific AWS operation.

methods.name: getIterator
methods.description: Provides an iterator to go through AWS API resources, utilizing pagination and search keys.

methods.name: waitUntil
methods.description: Waits for an AWS operation to reach a desired state, using a configured waiter.

methods.name: getWaiter
methods.description: Returns a waiter object configured for a specific AWS operation, with optional custom configuration.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Executes a command synchronously against AWS services.

methods.name: executeAsync
methods.description: Executes a command asynchronously against AWS services.

methods.name: __call
methods.description: Handles dynamic method calls, resolving to either synchronous or asynchronous AWS SDK methods, with support for method aliasing.

methods.name: getCommand
methods.description: Abstract method to retrieve a command object for a given operation name and parameters.

methods.name: getApi
methods.description: Abstract method to retrieve the AWS service API description object.
